question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a white present, Bob has a purple present, and Claire has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) white present
(B) purple present
(C) teal present
solution:
Gift colors are listed in the order Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: white, purple, teal.
1. Bob ↔ Alice: purple, white, teal.
2. Alice ↔ Claire: teal, white, purple.
3. Alice ↔ Bob: white, teal, purple.
Alice has the white present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
